about: What a deployment with pages.enabled off rendered for its identity and sign-in addresses, taken by tests/harness/pages_off_capture.py from the tree at `commit` (main before build id PL7, slice PL7f): rewritten only by that script (the test names how), never by hand.

values.yaml:
osprey.yaml: "profile: cloud-platform
components:
  graph_store: arcadedb
  analytics_engine: clickhouse
  post_ingest_resolution: true
  search: opensearch
  storage:
    data: /var/lib/osprey/data
    staging: /var/lib/osprey/staging
    backups: /var/lib/osprey/backups
    ingest: /var/lib/osprey/ingest
    tiles: /var/lib/osprey/tiles
models:
  local_only: true
  sendable_handling_codes: []
  providers: []
  defaults: {}
  extraction: qwen2.5:7b-instruct
  vision: moondream:1.8b-v2-q4_K_M
  transcription: Systran/faster-whisper-tiny.en
  embedding: all-minilm:22m-l6-v2-fp16
  extraction_engine: deep_read
governance:
  identity_provider: keycloak
  handling_scheme: uk-law-enforcement
  ontology: default
  real_data_exceptions: config/real_data_exceptions.yaml
cluster:
  hosts: []
  namespace: ospreyflow
cloud_platform:
  platform: client
  namespace: ospreyflow-dev
  environment: development
  registry: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com
  allow_from:
  - 192.0.2.0/24
  egress_nets:
    s3.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com:
    - 198.18.0.0/24
    sts.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com:
    - 198.18.1.0/24
    login.microsoftonline.com:
    - 198.18.2.0/24
  claims:
    tenant_id: 00000000-1111-4222-8333-444444444444
    client_id: bbbbbbbb-cccc-4ddd-8eee-ffffffffffff
    api_client_id: aaaaaaaa-bbbb-4ccc-8ddd-eeeeeeeeeeee
    token_version: '2.0'
    scope: access_as_user
    clearance:
      claim: extension_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef_clearance
    org_unit:
      groups:
        20000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001: unit-1
    handling_codes:
      groups:
        30000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001:
        - P
    groups_claim: groups
    first_administrators:
    - 50000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
    claims_mapping_policy: false
  connector_hosts: []
  connector_sources:
    s3: []
    athena: []
network:
  expose_conduit: false
  public_origin: https://osprey.example.org
  redirect_http: false
map:
  default: osm-local
  providers:
  - id: osm-local
    label: OpenStreetMap
    kind: vector
    licence:
      id: ODbL
      redistributable: true
      client_scope: open
    source: file:///data/tiles/osm-local.pmtiles
    variables: {}
    proxy: none
    style: bundled:osprey-dark
    attribution: "\xA9 OpenStreetMap contributors"
reporting:
  sync: false
  sync_interval_seconds: 900
  sync_memory: 256m
  superset: false
  superset_memory: 2g
monitoring:
  hotlist_audience: only_me
  hotlist_audience_editable: true
connectors:
  private_hosts: []
  secrets: []
welcome:
  about: true
deployment: {}
appearance:
  brand: ospreyflow
  phase: none
grading:
  scheme: 5x5x5
external: {}
resources:
  gpu: none
"
